findings.title: Real startup issues suite-policy certificates that integration rejects against the lease-policy digest
evidence: packages/config/src/config.ts:141 derives trustedCheckPolicyDigest as SHA256(JSON.stringify(trustedCheckPolicy)), the lease/check-list policy digest.

apps/control-plane/src/main.ts:41 configures TrustedCheckCoordinator.policyDigest from getCheckPolicy(checkId,...).digest, the actual full-suite verifier policy digest, and passes the separate config digest as leasePolicyDigest.

packages/contracts/src/sql-mission-store.ts:341-342 checks the lease digest separately but writes request.policyDigest into mission_slices.verification_policy_digest; lines 375 and 415 require that suite digest for receipt/certificate validity.

packages/governor/src/governor.ts:190 rejects a valid suite-policy certificate unless certificate.policyDigest equals config.trustedCheckPolicyDigest; packages/contracts/src/sql-mission-store.ts:68 and 76 independently require verification_policy_digest to equal the integration intent policy digest supplied as config.trustedCheckPolicyDigest.

The new tests/controller-authority.test.ts injects a coordinator-shaped stub and tests construction/route availability, not the real loadConfig -> trusted attempt -> SQL certificate -> integrateVerifiedSlice path with distinct digests.
findings.impact: With the configured mandatory node-repo-suite-v1 verifier, certification can succeed but local integration and subsequent delivery cannot complete. Equating the two digests only in the Governor check would still fail the SQL integration fence.
findings.boundedDirection: Resolve the lease/check-list and actual verifier-suite digest domains consistently at the integration boundary and SQL intent/finalization checks, retaining both fences and the runner's exact suite-policy check. Add a startup-shaped SQL integration regression that derives the two distinct digests via loadConfig/getCheckPolicy, issues a real certificate, and integrates that candidate. Re-freeze and rerun full gates plus independent review.
